user.title: Seamless Rename
user.description: Rename entities safely and update every consumer.

abort.already_configured: Seamless Rename is already set up.

plan.name: Plan rename
plan.description: Scan the configuration for an entity rename and store a plan without changing anything.

pattern.name: Pattern
pattern.description: Bulk rule with match, replace and optional domain.

include_uncertain.name: Include uncertain
include_uncertain.description: Also rewrite uncertain references (off by default).

renames.name: Renames
renames.description: List of objects with a from and a to entity ID for a bulk rename.

apply.name: Apply plan
apply.description: Back up, rewrite the configuration and rename the entities of a stored plan.

plan_id.name: Plan ID
plan_id.description: ID returned by the plan service.

exclude.name: Exclude
exclude.description: Finding IDs from the plan to leave unchanged.

undo.name: Undo rename
undo.description: Restore the files and entity IDs of a completed apply.

apply_id.name: Apply ID
apply_id.description: ID returned by the apply service.

force.name: Force
force.description: Overwrite files that changed after the apply.

audit.name: Audit references
audit.description: List references to entities that do not exist. Changes nothing.

references.name: List references
references.description: List every place that mentions an entity. Changes nothing.

init.title: Options
init.description: Show the panel in the sidebar and choose folders outside the Home Assistant configuration (Node-RED, pyscript, AppDaemon, Grafana, ...) that are searched for the old entity IDs. Hits are only reported, never changed.

data_description.show_panel: Turn this off to hide the Seamless Rename entry in the sidebar. Services and the websocket API keep working.
data_description.external_paths: Absolute folder paths, one per entry.

error.not_a_directory: Every path must be an existing folder.
error.protected_path: This folder is part of Home Assistant's internal storage and cannot be searched.

plan_not_found.message: This plan or backup does not exist: {error}

plan_blocked.message: The plan has blockers and cannot be applied: {error}

plan_stale.message: A file changed since the plan was made, plan again: {error}

plan_expired.message: The plan is too old, plan again: {error}

config_check_failed.message: Home Assistant rejected the changed configuration and the files were restored: {error}

apply_failed.message: The rename failed and was rolled back: {error}

unknown_finding.message: The selection contains a finding that is not part of the plan: {error}

confirm.title: Roll back the interrupted rename
confirm.description:
A rename apply ({apply_id}) did not finish, probably because Home Assistant stopped in the middle of it. Entities, files, dashboards or helpers may be half-changed.

Roll back apply {apply_id}? Files, dashboards, helpers and entity IDs are restored to the state before it started. Files, dashboards or helpers that you changed after the crash are not overwritten: the rollback stops and names them (use the undo service with force to override).
